name: Rum Runner
note: R8.5, Advanced Missions SSD p.141. Point value prints EPV/BPV (83/60). Its two Ph-1 fire on a 360 arc, which the sheet states outright, and it carries no drone racks at all - the rackFiringLimit is declared because FD4.4 binds every Orion, not because this hull can reach it unaided. ITS TWO OPTION MOUNTS ARE NOT ADJACENT (owner, 2026-10-20), so it may never take a two-mount weapon however many centerline mounts it shows - see BACKLOG on why adjacency has to be declared rather than inferred from the count. Sensor/scanner/damage-control tracks are five steps where the CA's are six; verified against the sheet. No plasma rack refit, no plus refit and no Y175 block: the sheet prints none, which fits a hull with no racks to convert.
